Access to the PsychGen Data Dictionary is now requested through an online form. Please use the form instead of sending requests by email.

## How to request access

1. Open the form: [Request access to the Data Dictionary](https://forms.cloud.microsoft/Pages/ResponsePage.aspx?id=IwyAw4_4N0aUgY1iakrg4EmxJpMLzP5JlBkhjPHdgulUM1ZTU1M2VVlSOVBQNDJXTFJXTExSUzgzWC4u){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}
2. Fill in your name, the email address you want to use for the Data Dictionary, your institution and your PsychGen contact person (if there is any).
3. Submit the form. You will hear from us within two working days.

## What happens next

* The PsychGen team checks your request.
* If it is approved, you receive an invitation from shinyapps.io at the email address you gave. Accept the invitation and sign in with an account linked to that address.
* Access is reviewed once a year. Please let us know when you no longer need it, for example when your project ends.

See the [Data dictionary](../docs/data_dictionary/index.qmd) page for the full steps, including how to create a Posit account.

Questions: [Yunpeng.Ding@lds.no](mailto:Yunpeng.Ding@lds.no)
